decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1) The proposed extension by reason of its excessive size and projection, flat roof design and poor relationship to the existing house, would result in a feature that would be obtrusive in the surrounding area and fail to enhance the character of the area. This is contrary to policies ENV. B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003; and the Residential Extension Guidelines 2004.

Condition : 2 - 2) The proposed garage by reason of its siting, size and design would intrude into an area along the section of the A4 that is currently well landscaped along its northern side, resulting in prominent feature that is out of keeping in the context within which it is set. This is contrary to policy ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003; and the Residential Extension Guidelines 2004.

Condition : 3 - Insufficient information has been submitted regarding the proposed access to the garage and visibility splays. Furthermore, it is considered that an access in this location would be prejudicial to the flow of traffic and highway safety, and that would also be out of character with the area. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and conversion of garage to living room, erection of detached double garage to exisiting dwellinghouse.
